nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: 08:00 Europe/Warsaw daily. The query reads complete days only, up to yesterday.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these after import. outputSheetId is the long id in the spreadsheet URL; outputSheetTab must already exist and is overwritten on every run.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "QueryString": "WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-01-01'                 AS date_from,     -- "all time"; the bound lets Athena prune partitions
           CURRENT_DATE                      AS date_to_excl,
           CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10' DAY  AS reg_from       -- 10 complete days; today is not included
),
-- Everyone with at least one successful deposit, on any brand.
depositors AS (
    SELECT b.player_hk
    FROM operator_ro_normcasino.agg_billing_daily b
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE b.as_of_date >= p.date_from
      AND b.as_of_date <  p.date_to_excl
      AND b.transaction_type   = 'deposit'
      AND b.transaction_status = 'Success'
      AND b.brand IN ('NORMCASINO', 'LACASINO', 'VOLKCASINO', 'IKRACASINO')
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING SUM(b.transaction_count) > 0
)
-- Column names must match COLUMNS in Parse Athena Page and Collect Export Rows.
SELECT ps.brand                                                    AS "Brand",
       ps.player_id                                                AS "User ID",
       dp.first_name                                               AS "First name",
       dp.phone                                                    AS "Phone Number",
       DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(ps.registration_date AS DATE),
                 CURRENT_DATE)                                     AS "Days Since Registration"
FROM operator_ro_normcasino.agg_player_summary ps
CROSS JOIN params p
LEFT JOIN depositors d
  ON d.player_hk = ps.player_hk
JOIN operator_ro_normcasino.d_player dp
  ON dp.player_hk = ps.player_hk
WHERE ps.is_test = false
  AND ps.brand IN ('NORMCASINO')
  -- Registered in the last 10 complete days.
  AND CAST(ps.registration_date AS DATE) >= p.reg_from
  AND CAST(ps.registration_date AS DATE) <  CURRENT_DATE
  AND ps.player_deleted_date IS NULL
  AND d.player_hk IS NULL
  -- Only players with a phone number.
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(dp.phone), '') IS NOT NULL
  -- No streamers.
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM operator_ro_normcasino.d_risk_tags_summary st
        WHERE st.player_hk = ps.player_hk
          AND st.tag_id = 39
  )
ORDER BY "Brand", "Days Since Registration", "User ID"
",
  "QueryExecutionContext": { "Database": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaDatabase }}", "Catalog": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaCatalog || 'AwsDataCatalog' }}" },
  "WorkGroup": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaWorkgroup || 'primary' }}",
  "ClientRequestToken": "n8n-registered-players-without-deposits-norm-execution-{{ $execution.id }}"
  {{ $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation ? ', "ResultConfiguration": { "OutputLocation": "' + $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation + '" }' : '' }}
}

nodes.name: Execute Athena Query
nodes.notes: ClientRequestToken is derived from the execution id, so a retry of this node rejoins the same Athena query instead of starting a second one.

nodes.name: Poll Attempts Remaining?
nodes.notes: true -> wait and poll again; false -> give up after 120 polls (~10 min)

nodes.name: Get Athena Results Page
nodes.notes: Called once per page. The first call comes from Athena Query State and has no nextToken; later calls come back from More Pages? carrying the token of the page before.

nodes.name: More Pages?
nodes.notes: true -> fetch the next page with this NextToken; false -> every page is in, build the sheet.

nodes.name: Clear Sheet
nodes.notes: Clears columns A:Z of the tab, wider than the data, so leftovers from a longer run or an older column layout do not linger. Runs only after every Athena page was read.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ range: $('Collect Export Rows').first().json.range, majorDimension: 'ROWS', values: $('Collect Export Rows').first().json.values }) }}

nodes.name: Write Rows to Sheet
nodes.notes: One values.update call: header row plus every player. Idempotent, so a retry rewrites the same cells.

nodes.name: Read Sheet Title
nodes.notes: Current title of the output spreadsheet, so Stamp Sheet Title keeps the name and only replaces the timestamp suffix.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ requests: [{ updateSpreadsheetProperties: { properties: { title: String($json.properties.title).replace(/\s*\(обновлено [^)]*\)\s*$/u, '') + ' (обновлено ' + $now.toFormat('dd.MM HH:mm') + ')' }, fields: 'title' } }] }) }}

nodes.name: Stamp Sheet Title
nodes.notes: Renames the output spreadsheet to "<name> (обновлено dd.MM HH:mm)", Europe/Warsaw time, replacing an earlier stamp. Runs last, only after the rows were written, so the stamp in the title means the data is fresh. All four export workflows share this spreadsheet and stamp the same title.
